shared_elements: carved relief on coarse weathered stone
justification: Both show a heavily weathered stone surface bearing an upright, roughly human-shaped form set against vertical divisions and a horizontal ledge or band, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a discrete free-standing monolith with deliberate, legible low-relief motifs (concentric disc, curved bands, patterned head) displayed indoors, while B is an in-situ rock face whose figures are barely distinguishable from natural erosion and cracking, with no comparable ornament or ordered composition.
